discussion_comments.comment_body: AI Review: This treats an empty marketplace result as "not fetched." Because `queryMarketplaceSnapshot()` rerenders after both an empty success and a failure, the next render starts another request, creating an unbounded request/render loop and bypassing the explicit Retry action. Track uninitialized, loading, loaded, and failed states separately, and only auto-fetch from the uninitialized state.

Valid and very helpful. An empty successful result and an uninitialized snapshot were both represented as an empty array, so rendering recursively retriggered the fetch. I introduced explicit uninitialized/loading/loaded/failed snapshot state; an empty success is now terminal until the marketplace configuration changes or the user retries after failure, with regression coverage. This feedback was already well framed as a state-machine bug. It could be improved further by asking for separate empty-success and failure/retry tests so both terminal states are protected.

Addressed in 535c9511acf. The runtime catalog lookup is now best-effort: a failed or unsupported `tools.getBuiltinDescriptors` RPC logs a session-scoped warning with the error and leaves the extension-native execution tool registered. `setTools` remains outside that catch, so failure to remove a confirmed duplicate still fails the launch and disconnects the session.

Added create/resume regressions for missing-method and ordinary RPC failures with the workbench runtime setting disabled; they assert successful launch, no tool replacement or disconnect, and the warning. All four failed before the fix. Client build and targeted lint passed; the full launcher test file passed (153 tests), including the existing fail-closed `setTools` regression.

Good catch, fixed in 07a1994aa4b. The service no longer resolves services through `invokeFunction`/`accessor.get`. A new `ConfigurationWriteErrorReporter` declares `INotificationService` and `IEditorService` in its constructor, and the configuration service creates it with `instantiationService.createInstance(...)` the first time a write fails, following the workbench `ConfigurationEditing` pattern. Creating it on first use avoids instantiating `IEditorService` during startup, before the layout exists.

AI Review: Refreshing while a dashboard control is focused saves its key and then removes the focused DOM here. If discovery fails, the error state renders Retry but never focuses it; only `showOverview` restores pending focus, which cannot happen until a retry succeeds. When an error replaces a focused dashboard, focus Retry or the error heading while retaining the overview key for later restoration.

Fixed in a79872d36cf. On failure, the capture now runs in a nested `finally` around `closeElectronApp`, so it happens even if closing throws. (`closeElectronApp` already catches its own errors and falls back to killing the process tree, but this makes the capture independent of that.)

> Co-authored with Copilot
